import numpy as np

def avsr(audio, video, audio_encoder, visual_encoder, decoder):
    audio_feat = audio_encoder(audio)
    visual_feat = visual_encoder(video)
    # Align temporal dimensions
    min_len = min(audio_feat.shape[0], visual_feat.shape[0])
    audio_feat = audio_feat[:min_len]
    visual_feat = visual_feat[:min_len]
    # Fuse
    fused = np.concatenate([audio_feat, visual_feat], axis=-1)
    # CTC decoding
    transcription = decoder(fused)
    return transcription
